import_provenance.original_title: Can quantifier-free updates maintain directed reachability?
import_provenance.original_statement: Is directed reachability maintainable under single-edge insertions and deletions by quantifier-free update formulas with a fixed finite collection of auxiliary relations of arbitrary fixed arity (DynProp)? Schwentick’s question is about unrestricted relational auxiliary arity, beyond known lower bounds for bounded-arity subclasses.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: First-order updates with quantifiers already maintain directed reachability (2015); that result does not settle DynProp.
